command:
$ErrorActionPreference='Continue'
Write-Output '--- GET-DISK ---'
Get-Disk | Select-Object Number,FriendlyName,SerialNumber,OperationalStatus,HealthStatus,IsOffline,PartitionStyle,Size,BusType | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String -Width 240
Write-Output '--- GET-PARTITION ---'
Get-Partition | Select-Object DiskNumber,PartitionNumber,DriveLetter,Type,Size | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String -Width 200
Write-Output '--- F-PROBE ---'
Write-Output "TestPath_F_root=$(Test-Path 'F:\')"
Write-Output "Win32LogicalDisk_F=$((Get-CimInstance Win32_LogicalDisk -Filter \"DeviceID='F:'\" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Measure-Object).Count)"
Write-Output '--- MOUNTEDDEVICES-LETTERS ---'
(Get-Item 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\MountedDevices' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).GetValueNames() | Where-Object { $_ -like '\DosDevices\*' } | Sort-Object
Write-Output '--- RC ---'
